BEAST Repeat.note: Expanded Beat Repeat with pitch, granular stretching, filtering and snapshots.

Boss DS-1 Distortion v1.1.note: Emulation of the Boss DS-1 distortion pedal; maxforlive page no longer online.

ChannelStrip.note: Modelled tube preamp with three-band EQ and an oscilloscope.

Colour.note: Analog-style colouration with six modes; part of ELPHNT's ESSENTIALS bundle.

Crap Cassette v1.0.note: Emulates a worn C90 cassette: noise, wow, flutter and dropouts.

Drox II Pro.note: Glitch multi-effect with dropout, CD-skip, tape stop and stutter engines.

Filter.note: Creative performance filter with analog character; part of ELPHNT's ESSENTIALS bundle.

GLITCH LOOP.note: Glitch looper that turns incoming audio into stuttering loops.

HarmoAdaptFilter J74.note: Adapts incoming MIDI to the selected chord and scale; part of J74 HarmoTools.

HarmoChordFilterAPI J74.note: Chord filtering module of the J74 HarmoTools bundle.

HarmoDisplay J74.note: Displays detected chords and scales; part of J74 HarmoTools.

HarmoScale J74.note: Detects and selects scales for the J74 HarmoTools system.

HarmoScaleRecv J74.note: Receives scale data from HarmoScale to constrain notes; part of J74 HarmoTools.

Image2Wavetable.note: Turns image files into single-cycle wavetables for Live's Wavetable.

Irrational Delay.note: Delay effect using irrational, non-grid delay time ratios.

Lood.note: Free monophonic bass synth with a ladder filter; sister device to Lode.

M2TM Progressions.note: Live 12 MIDI tool that generates harmonic chord progressions.

MFA Audio Cycler.note: Audio-triggered stepwise modulator from the free Mod Squad bundle.

MFA Cheat Code.note: Transforms stale or sloppy MIDI input into new musical ideas.

MFA Gain Tracker.note: Amplitude-based audio-rate modulator from the free Mod Squad bundle.

MFA MIDI Dubber.note: MIDI-triggered dub-throw value modulator from the free Mod Squad bundle.

MFA Manual S&H.note: Button-triggered random value generator from the free Mod Squad bundle.

MultiMapper32Audio V2.7.note: 32-dial macro mapper with a tabbed interface for mapping many parameters.

Nirvana C.note: Circuit-mode instrument version of Nirvana, a feedback simulation sandbox.

NirvanaFX SM.note: Effect version of Nirvana using its space and material feedback simulations.

Oxide v1.02.note: Tape simulation effect for Ableton Live.

Probee.note: Free random value generator triggered by incoming MIDI notes.

Radio Garden.note: Streams live radio stations from around the world into Live.

Schaeffer's Nightmare.note: Generative sampler dedicated to musique concrete pioneer Pierre Schaeffer.

Select + MAP Single Variation MIDI V1 Ab.note: Selects and MIDI-maps a single macro variation; part of the Macro Variations pack.

Smooth Automator MIDI.note: Creates automation and morphing between Live's macro variations.

TapPanZeit-v12.note: Delay turned inside out: sculpt the level and panning of each tap.

TransientDesigner.note: Shapes the attack and sustain transients of incoming audio.

bve.glitchlooper.note: Turns incoming audio into glitchy, bleepy stuttered loops.

j90 1.5.note: Phaser based on the MXR Phase 45, 90 and 100.

jL3v3ll3r v1.4.note: Clone of Dan Worrall's L3V3LL3R compressor Reaktor ensemble.

jOdyssey v6.0.note: Emulation of the ARP Odyssey synthesizer.

jRat v2.0.note: ProCo Rat distortion emulation with a turbo mode.

ml.distance.note: Places sounds at a distance using delay, filtering and reverb.

trnr.Duckling.note: Free MIDI-triggered ducker with an adjustable envelope.

trnr.TriplexClassic.note: Classic machine of Triplex, a retro FM synthesizer.
